items.title: Claymore
items.reason: Across its complete 26-episode anime run, half-human, half-Yoma warrior Clare hunts shapeshifting, flesh-eating demons in a bleak fantasy world. Disguise, hidden motives within the Organization, the limits and risks of Yoki release and Awakening, differing combat abilities, Clare's acquired techniques, and escalating Awakened threats supply supernatural rules, progressive revelations, tactical fights and meaningful power growth. The series features repeated intense sword battles, body horror, dismemberment, severe cruelty, tragic backstories and distinctive desaturated visual design. Limitations: adversarial psychological strategy is secondary to combat, formal training is intermittent, the 2000s aesthetic is prominent, Raki's separation/reunion subplot draws criticism, and the anime-original final episodes shift toward repetitive battles and leave major organizational mysteries unresolved.
